room_description: The interior of a sunken red car underwater. The player looks out through a cracked windshield into the ocean, with the dashboard, steering wheel, and leather seats visible.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot from the driver's seat of the sunken car.
Looks at the back seat and finds '689241' pressed into the leather.
Presses a button to pop open the glovebox, finding a grid clue on paper.
Enters '689241' into the password prompt on the center console screen.
Collects a gold disc from the dashboard near the cracked windshield.
A 3x3 grid puzzle of yellow and blue triangles appears on the screen.
Successfully matches the grid puzzle pattern to the glovebox clue.
A secret panel slides down, revealing an arrow button puzzle.
Solves the jumping arrow puzzle and collects a metal hammer.
Uses the hammer to violently smash the cracked windshield.

solution_steps: Examine the red leather back seat to find the indented numbers '689241'.
Type this exact sequence into the digital keypad on the center console screen.
puzzles.reward: Unlocks the screen to reveal a grid puzzle

solution_steps: Look at the paper clue from the glovebox showing a grid with a key icon.
Tap the squares on the digital 3x3 grid to change their colors (Lights Out style mechanics) until the correct pattern is formed.
puzzles.reward: Reveals a hidden panel under the steering wheel

solution_steps: Play the peg solitaire mini-game on the hidden panel.
Jump the green up-arrows over the blue down-arrows until all green arrows are at the top and blue arrows are at the bottom.

final_action: Takes the hammer and repeatedly strikes the cracked windshield until it shatters, allowing the player to swim out and escape.
